title: Fix inline comment stripping and quoted values in INI parser
prompt:
Fix the bugs in `ini_parser/parser.py`:
1. Inline comments starting with `#` or `;` outside of quotes should be stripped, while `#` or `;` inside single or double quotes must be preserved.
2. Surrounding matching quotes (`"..."` or `'...'`) on values should be unwrapped, and escaped quotes (`\"` or `\'`) inside quoted strings unescaped.
3. Keys appearing before any `[section]` header should go into the `'DEFAULT'` section.
Run `pytest` and verify edge cases.
